message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Specify phase complete for /testbed/specs/001-transactions (SPECIFY_FEATURE_DIRECTORY=specs/001-transactions, SPEC_FILE=specs/001-transactions/spec.md, 340 lines). Updated spec.md to the current frozen requirements while retaining all active earlier requirements: (1) Milestone 1 R01-R03 unchanged (put/get deep-copy contract, tag validation with pre-mutation ValueError, invalidate exact removal + recency/len semantics, maxsize positive non-bool int, invalid replacement atomicity, one slot per value); (2) Claim-A extension (put_no_recency_refresh, 2026-09-21) retained as an explicit candidate-extension assumption: overwrite-put refreshes LRU recency; (3) Milestone 2 added - new User Story 4 (bulk invalidation: any=union, all=every tag, empty requested tags remove ZERO in either mode, distinct-removed-keys return, invalid mode/tags ValueError before mutation, invalidate(tag) compatibility) and User Story 5 (resize: validate positive non-bool int first, survivors keep LRU order, shrink evicts LRU, grow evicts nothing, failed resize preserves all state, maxsize property reports current capacity), plus FR-014..FR-019, SC-006, and 8 new edge cases (duplicate tags, empty all-mode, generator tag sources, same-capacity no-op, shrink-to-exact, invalid capacity, grow-then-shrink round trip); (4) Conflicting evidence handled: the old design note 'empty all-tags matches every key and resizing may flush the cache' is explicitly recorded as superseded by R04/R05 in Assumptions and SC-006 requires tests proving those behaviors are NOT implemented; (5) Claim-A round 2 (2026-09-22) resize expiry clarification recorded as an assumption/open item: R07/R08 expiry requirements do not exist in the frozen set, so entries have no expiry attribute and 'preserve absolute expiry' is vacuously satisfied by preserving entry state as-is; if a TTL milestone lands, resize must preserve absolute expiry timestamps (no drop/recompute). Checklist checklists/requirements.md re-validated: 16/16 items [x], notes updated with the milestone-2 validation run; grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md -> 0 (no questions needed - all ambiguities resolvable from task facts). .specify/feature.json points to specs/001-transactions. No .specify/extensions.yml exists, so no hooks were checked or run. Ready for $speckit-plan / $speckit-tasks; implementation source remains src/cachetools/tagged.py with acceptance_public.py as the public gate."}
